title: 雨水貯留與非飲用供水~Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply
focus: 集水水量、儲槽時序、可靠度與用途隔離~Catchment yield, storage timing, reliability and separated uses
summary: 從屋頂降雨到使用端水量帳，逐步檢查雨水貯留系統的容量、時序與服務可靠度。十個原創單元包含初期分流、儲槽溢流、乾旱自主時間、抽水能耗與感測不確定度，並明確分開水力估算及水質用途驗證。以舊金山公用事業總部與Fort Buchanan官方案例作比較，不把不同設施的處理配置混為一談。~Follow roof rainfall through storage to end-use accounting, checking capacity, timing and service reliability. Ten original units cover diversion, overflow, dry-period autonomy, pumping energy and measurement uncertainty while separating hydraulic estimates from water-quality suitability. Official SFPUC headquarters and Fort Buchanan cases support comparison without treating their distinct treatment arrangements as interchangeable.
history: 舊金山公用事業委員會的2022年案例集記錄了2012年總部建築及其雨水系統，提供建築尺度水回用的歷史例子。美國能源部另列Fort Buchanan以雨水沖廁的非飲用案例，並提供雨水收集技術指南。本課使用這些背景說明集水、貯留與用途邊界的差別，不推定設施至今沒有改裝，也不把其他飲用雨水專案的規格直接移用。課程中的所有容積、流量與效率均為獨立教學假設，重點是能重現的水量帳和證據。~The SFPUC 2022 case collection documents its headquarters completed in 2012 and a rainwater system as a historical building-scale example. DOE separately lists nonpotable rainwater flushing at Fort Buchanan and provides harvesting guidance. These contexts distinguish collection, storage and use boundaries without assuming unchanged present configurations or transferring specifications from potable projects. All course volumes, flows and efficiencies are independent teaching assumptions, emphasizing reproducible accounting and evidence rather than a site installation prescription.
example: 教學假設五百平方公尺屋頂接受二十毫米降雨，體積逕流係數0.80得到8.0 m³。再從這個已算出的逕流量另扣0.5 m³分流，剩7.5 m³進槽；不能把同一初損再扣一次。若只改係數為0.60，扣分流前變成6.0 m³，比原先少25%。另取容量10 m³、初始4 m³的儲槽，先進水8 m³後用水3 m³，溢流2 m³而期末7 m³。這是另一個時序算例，不與前一個分流事件混帳。請逐一列出邊界、時段和所有去向，讓第三人能以守恆式重算。~Assume a five-hundred-square-metre roof receives twenty millimetres of rain with volumetric coefficient 0.80, yielding 8.0 m³. Separately divert 0.5 m³ from that calculated runoff, leaving 7.5 m³ for storage without subtracting the same initial loss twice. Changing only the coefficient to 0.60 gives 6.0 m³ before diversion, twenty-five percent lower. In a separate sequencing example, a 10 m³ tank initially holds 4 m³, receives 8 m³ and then supplies 3 m³, overflowing 2 m³ and ending at 7 m³. Do not merge these distinct event assumptions. List boundaries, intervals and every destination so another reader can independently reproduce all the conservation equations.

units.anchor: 屋頂集水與逕流體積~Roof catchment and runoff volume
units.title: 屋頂集水與逕流體積~Roof catchment and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 屋頂雨水量的第一個估算是水平投影集水面積乘以降雨深度，再以逕流係數表示濕潤、附著與其他初期損失的綜合影響。斜屋面的實際鋪面面積不能直接代替水平受雨面積，雨量站的位置也可能無法代表整片屋頂。單一係數是指定事件或期間的近似，不能同時當作峰值流量、污染去除率與設備效率。建立集水區邊界時應將不接入水槽的屋面另列，並區分屋頂雨水與地面暴雨逕流，因為它們的污染來源和輸送路徑不相同。~A first roof-yield estimate multiplies horizontal catchment area by rainfall depth and a runoff coefficient representing combined wetting and other losses. Sloping roof surface area is not the same as horizontal receiving area, and a distant gauge may not represent local rain. One coefficient approximates a specified event or period; it is not simultaneously a peak-flow factor, pollutant-removal efficiency and equipment efficiency. Delineate disconnected roof areas and distinguish rooftop rain from ground-level storm runoff with different contaminant pathways.
units.model: 教學假設水平屋頂面積500 m²、事件降雨20 mm與體積逕流係數0.80；收集前逕流體積V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³，尚未扣除後續分流與水槽溢流。~Assume a horizontal roof area of 500 m², event rainfall 20 mm and volumetric runoff coefficient 0.80. Runoff is V=500×0.020×0.80=8.0 m³ before diversion and tank overflow.
units.verify: 沿排水分區核對屋頂水平面積與實際接管，將雨量站累積值與量測時段對齊。以多場事件比較入口水量計和計算值，分別觀察短小降雨與長時間降雨的偏差，並保留屋頂維修或新增遮蔽物的日期以解釋係數變化。~Check horizontal areas and connected downpipes by drainage zone, aligning rainfall totals with meter intervals. Compare measured inlet volumes across short and prolonged events, recording roof maintenance and new obstructions so that changing collection performance can be traced to physical changes.
units.failure: 把傾斜屋面的鋪面面積當成受雨投影面積，會高估可收水量。若再忽略未接管區域及入口溢流，帳面水源可能足夠，水槽卻經常無法補滿；這不是單靠放大儲水槽就能修正的問題。~Using sloping surface area overstates rainfall capture. Ignoring disconnected areas and inlet bypasses can make theoretical supply appear adequate while tanks remain underfilled; increasing tank size does not repair an incorrectly defined catchment.
units.misconception: 只要知道屋頂鋪面總面積，就能把它全部當作有效水平集水面積。~The total sloping roof surface area always equals effective horizontal catchment area.
units.practice: 畫出四個屋頂排水分區，分別標示水平面積與接管去向。把其中一區改為排入一般雨水管後重算集水量，再將逕流係數從零點八降到零點六，說明面積與係數的不確定度如何分別影響估算。~Draw four roof drainage zones with horizontal areas and outlet destinations. Disconnect one zone and recalculate yield, then lower the runoff coefficient from 0.8 to 0.6 to distinguish the effects of catchment definition and coefficient uncertainty.

units.anchor: 初期分流與可利用水量~Initial diversion and usable yield
units.title: 初期分流與可利用水量~Initial diversion and usable yield
units.mechanism: 初期雨水分流會犧牲部分收集量，以改變進入儲槽的污染負荷，但固定體積分流不能證明所有污染已被移除。乾旱間隔、落塵、鳥類活動與屋面材料都會改變污染在事件中的分布。計算可利用水量時，應明確說明分流量是在逕流係數計算之前還是之後扣除，避免把同一損失算兩次。分流裝置的復位和剩餘水也會影響下一場事件，因此不能只檢查名目容積，還需知道每次事件實際進入與離開裝置的水量。~Initial diversion sacrifices some collected water and changes the contaminant load entering storage, but a fixed diverted volume does not prove complete contaminant removal. Dry intervals, deposition, wildlife and roof materials alter within-event loading. State whether diversion is subtracted before or after the runoff coefficient to avoid double-counting losses. Reset behavior and retained water affect the next event, so nominal vessel capacity alone is insufficient; record actual diversion and discharge for each event instead.
units.model: 教學假設從已計得8.0 m³屋頂逕流中，另分流0.5 m³；進槽量為7.5 m³。對500 m²集水面積，0.5 m³相當於1 mm逕流深度，僅為算例而非建議設定。~Assume 0.5 m³ is diverted from an already calculated 8.0 m³ runoff volume, leaving 7.5 m³. Over 500 m², diversion equals 1 mm of runoff depth; this is not a recommended setting.
units.verify: 以事件水量表分開記錄屋頂逕流、初期分流、入口旁通及真正進槽量。檢查裝置在前後兩場雨之間是否完成預定復位，並用適合用途的獨立水質採樣比較分流前後，不能以顏色變清或水量公式代替處理效果證據。~Keep separate event records for runoff, initial diversion, bypass and tank inflow. Check intended reset behavior between storms and compare appropriate independent water-quality samples before and after diversion; clearer appearance or a volume calculation does not establish treatment performance.
units.failure: 若把分流體積與已包含相同初損的逕流係數重複扣除，會低估供水量；若裝置未復位卻仍假設每場雨都分流，則可能高估水質控制效果。水量估算和水質驗證應各有證據。~Double-counting diversion within an already loss-adjusted coefficient underestimates supply. Assuming diversion occurs when the device has not reset can overstate quality control, so water balance and treatment performance require separate supporting evidence.
units.misconception: 初期分流達到某個固定體積後，剩餘雨水就一定符合所有非飲用用途要求。~After a fixed initial diversion, remaining rainwater automatically meets every nonpotable-use requirement.
units.practice: 為兩場相隔不同乾旱天數的合成降雨建立水量表，保持相同分流體積但改變污染負荷分布。說明相同可利用水量為何不代表相同水質，並提出一項能檢查裝置是否復位的紀錄欄位。~Build water balances for two synthetic storms with different dry intervals. Keep diversion volume constant while changing contaminant loading, explain why equal usable volumes need not have equal quality, and define a record that checks device reset.

units.anchor: 有限儲槽與事件時序~Finite storage and event ordering
units.title: 有限儲槽與事件時序~Finite storage and event ordering
units.mechanism: 儲水槽容量有限，入流、溢流與需求發生的先後會影響最後可利用的水量。每日總雨量和總需求相同，仍可能因下雨與用水時間不同而得到不同溢流。計算時應選擇足以辨識重要事件的時間步長，並明確列出先進水後用水或逐時同步計算的假設。容量限制只能截住儲量，超出的水必須作為溢流保留在水量帳中，不能直接消失；同樣地，需求超過存水時應記錄未滿足需求，而不是容許儲量變成負值。~Finite tank capacity makes the order of inflow, overflow and demand consequential. Equal daily rainfall and demand totals can yield different overflow when their timing changes. Choose a time step resolving important events and state whether inflow precedes demand or is integrated concurrently. Capacity limits constrain storage but do not erase excess water: overflow remains in the balance. When demand exceeds available water, record unmet demand instead of allowing negative storage or silently inventing additional supply.
units.model: 教學假設容量10 m³、初始4 m³，先一次進水8 m³再用水3 m³；進水後溢流2 m³，期末存水7 m³。守恆為4+8=2+3+7，僅適用明列的事件順序。~Assume capacity 10 m³ and initial storage 4 m³, with 8 m³ inflow before 3 m³ demand. Overflow is 2 m³ and final storage 7 m³; 4+8=2+3+7 for this stated order.
units.verify: 逐步列出期初存水、入流、溢流、實際供水、未滿足需求與期末存水，對每一步檢查守恆。用較短時間步長重算同一事件，確認溢流差異來自時序而非程式錯誤，並以水位容量曲線檢查感測水位轉換成體積的方式。~Tabulate initial storage, inflow, overflow, delivered demand, unmet demand and final storage, checking each balance. Repeat with finer timing to distinguish sequence effects from coding errors, and verify the level-to-volume conversion against the tank geometry rather than assuming constant area.
units.failure: 直接把一天總入流減總需求後再限制容量，可能把先前已溢出的水留在帳面上，造成虛假的供水能力。若水位計零點改變，期初期末存水差也可能看起來不守恆，需要另查幾何與校正。~Subtracting daily demand before imposing capacity can retain water that overflowed earlier, creating fictitious supply. A changed level-sensor zero can also mimic imbalance, requiring separate checks of tank geometry and instrument calibration.
units.misconception: 每日雨量和用水總量相同時，入流與需求的時間順序完全不會影響溢流。~With equal daily rainfall and demand totals, event ordering never affects overflow.
units.practice: 把算例改成先用水三立方公尺再進水八立方公尺，重算期末存水與溢流。接著改為每小時交錯進出水，說明哪一種時間解析度才能保留關鍵事件，並列出兩種順序都必須滿足的水量等式。~Reverse the example by using three cubic metres before receiving eight, then recalculate storage and overflow. Introduce alternating hourly inflow and demand, explaining the required temporal resolution and writing the balance equation that both event orders must satisfy.

units.anchor: 供水日數與供水量可靠度~Time-based and volumetric reliability
units.title: 供水日數與供水量可靠度~Time-based and volumetric reliability
units.mechanism: 雨水系統的可靠度必須先定義分母，否則不同指標可能被誤當成同一件事。完全滿足需求的天數比例描述使用者有多少天不需補充水源；總供水量占總需求量的比例則描述替代水量，兩者對高需求日的權重不同。研究期間若刻意避開乾季，任何可靠度都可能偏高。分析應使用對應用途的需求時序與降雨紀錄，並同時報告未滿足需求的頻率、總量及最長連續期間，讓短暫小缺水與長時間大缺水的差異清楚呈現。~Reliability requires an explicit denominator. The fraction of days with fully met demand describes service continuity, whereas delivered volume divided by total demand describes water substitution; high-demand days receive different weights. Excluding dry seasons can inflate either measure. Use rainfall and demand sequences matching the intended use and report shortage frequency, total shortage and the longest consecutive shortage period, distinguishing brief small deficits from prolonged large ones instead of presenting one unlabeled percentage.
units.model: 教學假設四日需求依序1、1、1、17 m³，實際供水1、1、1、7 m³；完全滿足日數比例3/4=75%，總量可靠度10/20=50%，兩者分母不同。~Assume four daily demands of 1, 1, 1 and 17 m³, with deliveries of 1, 1, 1 and 7 m³. Fully served days are 75%, while volumetric reliability is 50%; denominators differ.
units.verify: 在報告中為每個百分比列出分子、分母、期間與需求定義，將乾季和雨季分開檢查。利用完整日序列尋找連續缺水天數，再核對備援水源實際供水是否被錯算成雨水替代量，避免把總服務可靠度與雨水自身貢獻混淆。~List numerator, denominator, period and demand definition for each percentage, examining wet and dry seasons separately. Identify consecutive shortage days from the full sequence and check whether backup supply has been incorrectly credited to rainwater rather than overall service continuity.
units.failure: 只報告滿足日數比例，可能忽略少數高需求日的大量缺水；只報告年度替代量，也可能掩蓋連續乾旱時使用者完全依賴備援。兩種問題需要不同的管理對策，不能用一個高百分比相互抵消。~A high fraction of served days can conceal major deficits on a few demanding days. High annual substitution can likewise hide complete backup dependence through a dry spell; these different service problems cannot cancel each other through one favorable percentage.
units.misconception: 供水日數可靠度是百分之七十五，就代表全年需求水量也一定滿足百分之七十五。~Seventy-five-percent daily reliability always means seventy-five percent of demand volume is supplied.
units.practice: 將最大需求日改成兩天較小需求，保持總需求不變，重算兩種可靠度。再排列相同缺水天數為連續和分散兩種順序，說明指標數值可能相同但備援壓力不同，並設計一項補充指標。~Split the largest demand into two smaller days while preserving total volume and compare reliability measures. Arrange identical shortage days consecutively and separately, explaining why equal aggregate scores can impose different backup requirements and proposing a supplementary metric.

units.anchor: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積~Dry-period autonomy and usable volume
units.title: 乾旱自主時間與可用容積~Dry-period autonomy and usable volume
units.mechanism: 無雨期間可以支持多久，取決於真正可抽取容積與需求，而不只是水槽的外觀容量。底部沉積保留區、最低抽水水位與預留容量會減少可用水量；需求又可能隨氣候、使用人數或灌溉時段變動。用固定需求相除得到的自主天數，是特定假設下的簡化指標，不能當作乾旱發生機率或全年可靠度。若需求具有尖峰，還需確認輸送設備的瞬時能力，因此足夠的總容積也不保證每個使用時段都能供應。~Dry-period autonomy depends on extractable storage and demand, not merely the visible tank capacity. Sediment zones, minimum pumping levels and reserved volume reduce availability, while weather, occupancy and irrigation scheduling change consumption. Dividing by constant demand gives a conditional autonomy estimate, not a drought probability or annual reliability. Peak use also requires adequate delivery capacity, so sufficient total volume does not guarantee that every short demand interval can be served at the required rate.
units.model: 教學假設名目容量8 m³，其中2 m³不可抽取，固定需求0.75 m³/day且無入流；可用6 m³可支持6/0.75=8日。若需求增至1 m³/day，自主時間降為6日。~Assume an 8 m³ tank with 2 m³ unavailable, no inflow and constant demand 0.75 m³/day. Usable volume supports eight days; increasing demand to 1 m³/day reduces autonomy to six days.
units.verify: 用實際水位容量曲線確認最低可用水位和沉積區，將名目容量、可抽取容量及保留量分列。以多段乾旱期間的需求紀錄重算，而非只採全年平均需求，並核對備援啟動條件是否與分析假設一致，避免高估無雨期間可持續的服務。~Use the actual level-volume curve to separate nominal, extractable and reserved capacity. Recalculate with demand records from multiple dry spells instead of annual averages, and verify that backup activation assumptions match the intended service arrangement before interpreting calculated autonomy.
units.failure: 如果把不能抽取的底部存水算入自主容量，模型會在現場已經無水可用時仍顯示剩餘天數。用雨季平均需求估計乾季灌溉，也可能同時高估供應與低估需求，使誤差向同一方向累積。~Including inaccessible bottom water predicts remaining service after usable storage is exhausted. Applying wet-season demand to dry-season irrigation can simultaneously overstate supply and understate consumption, compounding the error in the same direction.
units.misconception: 儲槽名目容量除以全年平均需求，就一定是任何乾旱期間都能保證的自主天數。~Nominal tank capacity divided by annual average demand guarantees autonomy during every drought.
units.practice: 建立名目容量不變但沉積區逐年增加的三個情境，重算可用容積與自主天數。再加入乾季需求增加的情境，區分維護造成的容量變化與使用方式造成的需求變化，提出需要監測的兩個獨立量。~Compare three scenarios with unchanged nominal capacity but increasing sediment storage, recalculating usable volume and autonomy. Add higher dry-season demand, distinguish maintenance-related capacity loss from demand change, and identify two independent quantities that require monitoring.

units.anchor: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程~Pumping energy and total dynamic head
units.title: 抽水能耗與系統總揚程~Pumping energy and total dynamic head
units.mechanism: 將儲存雨水送到使用點需要克服高差、管路摩擦與設備局部損失，這些共同形成泵浦所需的總揚程。液壓功率與流量及揚程成正比，電力輸入還需除以整體效率；只用馬達銘牌功率乘時間，未必能反映實際輸送的水量。設備在不同工作點的效率會改變，小流量頻繁啟停也可能增加每立方公尺的能耗。比較節水方案時應保持供水服務相同，同時記錄輔助耗電與運轉時間，才能判斷替代水源帶來的水與能源取捨。~Delivering stored rainwater requires elevation, pipe-friction and local-loss head. Hydraulic power scales with flow and total head, while electrical input also depends on overall efficiency. Nameplate power multiplied by time need not represent actual delivered volume. Efficiency varies with operating point, and frequent starts at small demand can increase specific energy. Compare alternatives at equivalent service and include auxiliary electricity and operating duration to assess the relationship between freshwater substitution and energy use.
units.model: 教學假設淡水流量2 m³/h、總揚程15 m、整體效率0.50；輸入功率P=1000×9.81×(2/3600)×15/0.50=163.5 W，單位水量能耗0.08175 kWh/m³，未含待機。~Assume freshwater flow 2 m³/h, total head 15 m and overall efficiency 0.50. Electrical input is 163.5 W, equivalent to 0.08175 kWh/m³, excluding standby and auxiliary energy.
units.verify: 用同一時段的電表與水量計計算實測單位能耗，並記錄吸入口、出水口壓力及高程以核對總揚程。把運轉、啟停與待機時段分開，再比較不同流量下的工作點，不以單一效率假設套用整個年度。~Calculate measured specific energy from synchronized electricity and water meters, checking total head with inlet and outlet pressures and elevations. Separate running, starting and standby periods, and compare operating points across flows rather than extending one efficiency assumption over an entire year.
units.failure: 忽略濾網堵塞造成的額外水頭損失，可能把能耗上升誤認成馬達效率降低。若水量計和電表期間不同，也可能出現虛假的節能效果，因此應先核對服務量與量測邊界，再判斷設備性能。~Unmodeled screen losses can make rising energy use appear to be motor degradation. Mismatched electricity and water-meter intervals can also create false savings, so verify delivered service and measurement boundaries before diagnosing equipment performance.
units.misconception: 雨水是免費降下來的，所以抽水和處理過程必定不會消耗能源。~Because rainfall is free, pumping and treating collected rainwater necessarily require no energy.
units.practice: 將總揚程增加五公尺但保持流量與效率不變，重算功率和單位能耗。再加入每天固定的待機電量，分析用水量降低時每立方公尺能耗為何可能上升，並列出應與節水量一起報告的能源資料。~Increase total head by five metres while holding flow and efficiency fixed. Add fixed daily standby electricity and explain why lower water use can increase energy per cubic metre, listing energy measurements to report alongside freshwater savings.

units.anchor: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力~Screen losses and inlet conveyance
units.title: 濾網損失與入口輸送能力~Screen losses and inlet conveyance
units.mechanism: 入口濾網攔截粗大雜物時，也會改變通水面積與局部水頭損失。流速提高通常使慣性損失增加，但損失係數必須與使用的流速基準一致，不能同時縮小有效面積又重複加入代表相同堵塞的修正。濾網孔徑與水力通量也不是微生物去除能力的替代指標。研究暴雨進槽能力時，要連同屋簷溝、落水管和旁通溢流的控制位置一起判讀，因為最先受限的部位可能在濾網上游，僅更換較大的儲槽無法改變入口瓶頸。~An inlet screen changes open area and local head loss while intercepting coarse debris. Increasing velocity generally increases inertial loss, but the loss coefficient must match its reference velocity; reducing area and adding an equivalent blockage correction can double-count the same effect. Aperture and hydraulic throughput do not establish microbial removal. Evaluate gutters, downpipes and bypass controls together because the limiting section may lie upstream of the screen, where a larger storage tank cannot remove the inlet bottleneck.
units.model: 教學假設以指定參考截面速度v=0.8 m/s及相應損失係數K=5估算，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m。此為局部水力損失，不能換算成污染物去除率。~Assume reference-section velocity 0.8 m/s and a corresponding loss coefficient K=5. Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.1631 m; this hydraulic quantity does not specify pollutant-removal efficiency.
units.verify: 在相同流量下記錄濾網前後水位差，核對係數所使用的參考截面並保留清潔前後狀態。同步觀察旁通溢流是否開始，以判斷實際進槽受哪個位置控制；水質處理效果則使用另一套採樣與驗證紀錄，不能從水頭損失直接推算。~Measure the differential level at matched flow and verify the coefficient reference section, recording clean and fouled conditions. Observe bypass onset to identify the controlling inlet component. Maintain separate sampling evidence for treatment performance rather than deriving removal from hydraulic loss.
units.failure: 同時使用縮小的開孔流速與已含堵塞效應的係數，可能重複放大損失。反過來，僅看到水能通過就忽略濾網破損，則會把較低水頭差誤判成更好的過濾性能，水力和完整性應分別確認。~Using an increased opening velocity with a coefficient already corrected for the same blockage may overpredict loss. A damaged screen can instead show lower differential head, so easy passage is not evidence of improved filtration or intact barriers.
units.misconception: 濾網前後水頭損失越小，就能證明它的污染物去除能力越好。~A smaller pressure loss across a screen proves better pollutant-removal performance.
units.practice: 在固定參考截面下把流量增加一倍，先用不變係數估計損失變化，再指出係數也可能改變的原因。建立清潔、堵塞與破損三種狀態的診斷表，說明各自需要哪些水力與外觀證據。~Double flow at a fixed reference section and estimate loss using unchanged coefficient, then discuss why that coefficient may vary. Compare clean, blocked and damaged states, identifying the hydraulic and inspection evidence needed to distinguish them.

units.anchor: 完全混合與舊水殘留~Complete mixing and retained old water
units.title: 完全混合與舊水殘留~Complete mixing and retained old water
units.mechanism: 水槽的平均停留時間是體積除以交換流量，但不是每個水團停留完全相同的時間。若水槽保持定容積並完全混合，持續進入的新水會稀釋舊水，舊水比例以指數衰減；短路流與死水區則會偏離這個理想模型。單純把一天用水量乘以天數，不能推斷整槽已被百分之百換新。水齡也不是水質的單一判準，因為溫度、污染來源與處理狀態仍會影響用途適合性，應把水力更新與水質驗證作為互相補充的證據。~Mean residence time is volume divided by exchange flow, not an identical age for every parcel. In a constant-volume, completely mixed tank, fresh inflow dilutes old water exponentially; short circuits and stagnant zones depart from this idealization. Multiplying demand by elapsed days does not show that every part has been replaced. Water age alone also does not establish quality because temperature, source loading and treatment condition matter, so hydraulic turnover and quality verification provide complementary evidence.
units.model: 教學假設定容積10 m³、等量進出流1 m³/h、完全混合且新水不含舊水示蹤；六小時後舊水比例exp(−Qt/V)=exp(−0.6)=0.5488，不是已全部更新。~Assume a constant 10 m³ completely mixed tank with equal inflow and outflow of 1 m³/h and fresh inlet tracer concentration zero. After six hours, the old-water fraction is exp(−0.6)=0.5488.
units.verify: 在合成資料或經核准的專業示蹤研究中比較出口濃度與理想混合曲線，檢查初期快速到達及後期長尾。以不同水位與進出水配置分別評估，並記錄模型把哪一部分容積視為有效混合區，避免用單次平均停留時間掩蓋死水區。~Compare an outlet tracer curve with ideal mixing using synthetic data or an approved professional tracer study, examining early arrival and late tails. Evaluate different levels and inlet arrangements, documenting which volume participates in mixing rather than hiding stagnant zones behind one mean residence time.
units.failure: 將平均停留時間誤解為最長水齡，會低估死水區或混合槽中的長尾。若只在出口量測單一時間點，可能錯過早期短路與後期殘留，因此一次良好濃度值不能證明整個流場均勻。~Treating mean residence time as the maximum age understates long tails in mixed or stagnant regions. A single outlet observation can miss early bypass and late retention, so one satisfactory concentration does not demonstrate a uniform internal flow field.
units.misconception: 當累積出水量等於水槽容積時，槽內每一滴舊水就必定已經排出。~Once cumulative outflow equals tank volume, every original water parcel has necessarily left.
units.practice: 計算經過一個與兩個名目停留時間後的舊水比例，與理想活塞流比較。再假設只有部分容積參與快速混合，畫出可能出現的長尾形狀，說明為何需要多時間點而不是單一出口樣本。~Calculate old-water fractions after one and two nominal residence times and compare ideal plug flow. Introduce a slowly exchanging region, sketch the expected tail and explain why multiple observation times are needed instead of one outlet sample.

units.anchor: 分離供水與回流水力判讀~Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation
units.title: 分離供水與回流水力判讀~Separated supplies and reverse-flow interpretation
units.mechanism: 非飲用供水與飲用供水之間的隔離是系統邊界，不能因為正常時壓力方向看似有利就視為永遠安全。停電、泵浦狀態改變或供水壓力下降，可能反轉壓差；單一止回元件的存在也不能代替按用途和地區要求驗證完整防護。課堂可用互不連接的示意壓力節點分析驅動方向，但不應建立實際交叉接管實驗。資料圖、管線標示、補水介面與獨立檢驗紀錄需一致，才能證明設計意圖沒有在後續維修或改裝中被改變。~Separation between nonpotable and potable supplies is a system boundary, not a conclusion drawn from a favorable normal pressure direction. Power loss, pump changes or lower supply pressure can reverse a gradient. One check component does not replace verification of complete protection appropriate to use and jurisdiction. Analyze disconnected schematic pressure nodes in class without constructing cross-connections. Drawings, identification, makeup interfaces and independent inspection records must remain consistent through later maintenance and modification.
units.model: 純示意教學假設同高程兩個未相連節點，非飲用側200 kPa、另一側100 kPa；壓差100 kPa相當於100000/(1000×9.81)=10.19 m淡水水頭。若錯誤相連即有反向驅動可能，絕不可據此建立接管。~For disconnected teaching nodes at equal elevation, assume nonpotable-side pressure 200 kPa and the other side 100 kPa. The difference equals 10.19 m freshwater head and illustrates a reverse-driving potential if improperly connected, not permission to connect systems.
units.verify: 僅在紙上或隔離的數值模型中比較正常、停電與壓力下降情境，確認不能靠壓差方向作永久防護。審查時核對最新版管線圖、標示與具資格人員的檢驗紀錄，將未知介面列為待查事項，不以未曾發生回流作為系統隔離已證實的理由。~Compare normal, outage and reduced-pressure cases only on paper or in an isolated numerical model. Review current drawings, labels and qualified inspection records, documenting unknown interfaces rather than treating the absence of an observed reverse-flow event as proof of separation.
units.failure: 用正常運轉壓力推論任何時候都不會回流，忽略了短暫低壓與維修配置。若後續加裝一條未記錄的補水管，原先正確的分析也不再描述現況，因此介面變更必須觸發重新查核。~Inferring permanent flow direction from normal pressure overlooks transients and maintenance configurations. An undocumented makeup connection can invalidate a previously correct assessment, so interface changes must trigger renewed review instead of inheriting an old conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要正常時飲用側壓力較高，就永遠不需要考慮非飲用水回流。~Higher potable-side pressure during normal operation permanently eliminates reverse-flow concerns.
units.practice: 用兩個互不連接的壓力節點製作三種數值情境，標出壓差改變方向的條件。最後列出需要由合格專業人員確認的介面證據，不設計實體交叉接管、不提出替代法規防護的臨時操作方式。~Create three numerical scenarios using two disconnected pressure nodes and identify conditions reversing the gradient. List interface evidence requiring qualified review without designing a physical cross-connection or proposing temporary procedures that substitute for required protection.

units.anchor: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度~Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty
units.title: 替代水量帳與量測不確定度~Substitution accounting and measurement uncertainty
units.mechanism: 宣稱雨水替代了多少自來水，需要先界定水量帳的邊界，包括入槽雨水、備援補水、實際使用、溢流與期末存量。只看儲槽出水表可能把補入的自來水一併當成雨水貢獻。各儀表的不確定度若獨立，可由平方和開根號合併；共同校正偏差或相同演算法造成的誤差則可能相關，不能直接套用獨立公式。分析期間也需一致，否則季末大量存水會被錯誤算成已節省的用水量，讓年度績效看起來比真正服務量更高。~Rainwater substitution claims need a balance boundary including rainfall inflow, backup makeup, actual use, overflow and closing inventory. A tank outlet meter alone may count municipal makeup as harvested supply. Independent measurement uncertainties combine through a root-sum-square relation, whereas common calibration or processing errors can be correlated. Match accounting periods as well: water stored at year-end is not yet delivered service, and crediting it as consumption savings can overstate the achieved substitution.
units.model: 教學假設兩項水量差值的獨立標準不確定度分別20與10 m³；合併標準不確定度u=√(20²+10²)=22.36 m³。若誤差相關，需加入協方差，不能沿用此值。~Assume independent standard uncertainties of 20 and 10 m³ for two volumes used in a difference. Combined standard uncertainty is √(20²+10²)=22.36 m³; correlated errors require a covariance term.
units.verify: 將所有水量表讀值對齊同一開始與結束時間，獨立列出備援補水及存量變化。檢查儀表校正來源與誤差相關性，再用水量閉合差尋找漏列項；報告節省量時同時列出不確定度與資料缺漏，不能把估算值顯示更多小數位就視為較準確。~Align all meter readings to common endpoints and separate backup supply from inventory change. Check calibration provenance and error correlation, then use balance closure to locate omissions. Report uncertainty and missing data alongside savings rather than implying accuracy through additional displayed decimals.
units.failure: 若一邊採用月初表讀值、另一邊採月中表讀值，水量帳可能出現不存在的損失或節省。將共用偏差當作獨立隨機誤差，也會低估合併不確定度，使績效差異看似顯著但實際證據不足。~Mismatched meter endpoints can create apparent losses or savings that never occurred. Treating common bias as independent random error may understate combined uncertainty, making a performance difference appear significant without sufficient supporting evidence.
units.misconception: 儲槽出水表顯示的所有水量，都可以直接當作雨水替代自來水的節省量。~Every volume recorded at the tank outlet can be credited directly as rainwater substitution.
units.practice: 建立包含備援補水、雨水、溢流與存量變化的年度水量帳，先核對守恆再計算替代量。比較獨立誤差與完全同向共同偏差的兩種假設，說明為何不確定度的合併方式需要儀表來源證據。~Build an annual balance including makeup, rain, overflow and inventory change, verifying conservation before calculating substitution. Compare independent errors with perfectly shared bias and explain why the uncertainty combination requires evidence about calibration and measurement provenance.

facts: 本課10個單元分開水力估算與用途水質驗證。~The 10 units distinguish hydraulic estimation from end-use quality verification.
教學集水面積500 m²與20 mm降雨產生8.0 m³逕流。~The teaching 500 m² roof and 20 mm rainfall produce 8.0 m³ runoff.
教學0.5 m³初期分流不代表固定水質合格門檻。~The teaching 0.5 m³ diversion is not a quality-acceptance threshold.
教學供水日數75%與供水總量50%可靠度不相同。~Teaching daily reliability of 75% differs from volumetric reliability of 50%.
教學可用6 m³存水在固定需求下支持8日。~The teaching usable storage of 6 m³ supports eight days at the stated demand.
教學六小時後舊水比例0.5488反映理想完全混合。~The teaching old-water fraction of 0.5488 after six hours assumes ideal complete mixing.
